I intend simplify_onboarding because it is supported by two independent memories (memory_31 on signup field reduction, memory_86 on onboarding length) and sits upstream of the activation metric, meaning a win there should propagate. Caveats I am holding open rather than resolving: memory_31 and memory_86 are 64 and 24 days stale respectively and were measured in a pre-competitor market, so the effect sizes may not transfer; simplification that strips qualifying fields can raise raw activation while degrading lead quality, which would inflate the metric and deflate qualified revenue — the exact failure mode the discount produced.
